"''One more word, I take it all.|Padu Cherd pleads with Groff Ditcher|audio=Cherd-Ditcher-OBK1.flac|}} '''Padu Cherd''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a laborer at [[Tibidon Station]], a [[tibidon sand whale]]–harvesting station on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. After one shift in [[9 BBY]], he discovered that he had only received half his pay and pleaded with [[foreman]] [[Groff Ditcher]] for the rest, as he had a family. Ditcher shoved Cherd and sent him away with a threat that he would take the rest of the worker's pay if he spoke another word. ==Biography== {{Quote|Keep moving.|Groff Ditcher sends Padu Cherd away after threatening him|audio=Ditcher-Moving-OBK1.flac|}} [[File:CherdPunchOut-KenobiPartI.png|thumb|right|300px|Padu Cherd worked at Tibidon Station.]] Padu Cherd was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a laborer at [[Tibidon Station]], a sand whaling station in the [[desert]]s of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The workers at the station harvested [[Foodstuff|meat]] from the carcass of a huge [[tibidon sand whale]]{{SW|url=obi-wan-kenobi-part-i-trivia-gallery|text=Part I Trivia Gallery | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} {{C|Slide 2}} that they then chopped up into bricks on an assembly line. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} Cherd completed a shift at the site, and when a whistle sounded, he went to collect his pay from a [[power droid]] with a [[payment dispenser]] attached to its head. After inserting his [[punch disc]] and collecting the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] that were dispensed, Cherd realized he had only been paid half of his wages. He approached the [[foreman]], [[Groff Ditcher]], and pleaded with him for the rest in order to support his family. Ditcher shoved Cherd away, slamming him in the [[stomach]], and threatened to take the rest of his pay if he said another word. Clutching his stomach, Cherd silently moved away toward the transport that returned workers to the town of [[Anchorhead]]. [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who also worked at the station, watched the encounter but did not intervene. ==Personality and traits== Padu Cherd pleaded with Ditcher for his family's sake but accepted the half pay without further complaint after the foreman pushed and threatened him. Cherd had light skin, brown [[eye]]s, and graying [[hair]] that included a grizzled goatee. ==Equipment== Cherd wore a red [[Clothing|shirt]], brown pants, brown [[boot]]s, a brown apron, and a blue [[Hat|cap]]. He used a large [[knife]] while working at the station. ==Behind the scenes== Padu Cherd was portrayed by [[Chad Parker]] in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series, which aired on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-26|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} The Tibidon Station scenes were the first filmed for the series''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' and were captured using the technology known as "the Volume."{{WebCite|url=https://wrestlingjunkies.wixsite.com/wrestlingjunkies/heath-mcgough-interview|text=Heath McGough Interview - Between Obi Wan Kenobi , Miracle Workersand the Star Wars Family|author=Lorenz, Bernd|date=2022-10-15|work=The Entertainment Junkie|archivedate=20231103091515}} Cherd's name is not spoken in the episode, but it appears in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' {{Video}} *{{Topps|set=2024 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Worker Padu Cherd|nobackup=1}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Padu Cherd}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Padu Cherd |es=Padu Cherd |fr=Padu Cherd |ja=パドゥ・チャード |ka=პადუ ჩერდი |nl=Padu Cherd |pl=Padu Cherd |pt=Padu Cherd }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cherd, Padu}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
